page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, top to bottom, with the closing word FINIS centred below it. Running head at the top. Faint show-through of the reverse page in the lower half, not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: & Logicum contra omnium hæreticorum errores disputare, quippe qui videat non modo quid contra falsum dici possit, vt candidissime dicit Schegkius, nobilis ille φιλόσοφος & doctrinæ sacræ minime omnium rudis.

I nunc & sine discrimine clama perpetuo de excludenda Ratione Humana à Tractatione rerum Sacrarum, qua quidem vociferatione id videris postulare (quod λίαν μέγα αἴτημα est) vt homines sint animalia bruta, quibus ipse tanquam vulpes anseribus impune quiduis concionari possis.

page.notes: The Greek words are reproduced from the scan and may contain small errors in accents. Greek phrases "φιλόσοφος", "λίαν μέγα αἴτημα" are set in italic type in the print. The word "FINIS" is set in spaced capitals, centred.
